subHeadline: The question every Land Rover owner eventually faces, answered honestly rather than sold around. We tell you when to repair, when to replace, and when to scrap — based on real UK data, not estimates.

verdict.label: WATCH
verdict.text: Sub-£10k examples approach the threshold. Service history matters more than mileage.

verdict.label: SCRAP THRESHOLD
verdict.text: Recon cost frequently exceeds car value on older examples.

verdict.label: SAFE
verdict.text: Replacement viable across most examples — well within value even at upper recon cost.

verdict.label: SAFE
verdict.text: Well within value even at upper recon cost. The safest-to-buy generation.

verdict.label: SAFE
verdict.text: Very safe across all variants. High host value means replacement is always viable.

verdict.label: WATCH
verdict.text: Older examples sit at 40–60% of vehicle value. Get a scrap valuation alongside any repair quote.

ruleOfThumb.title: THE RULE OF THUMB
ruleOfThumb.text: If reconditioned engine cost runs at 60% or more of what your car is actually worth on today's market, get a scrap valuation alongside any repair quote — don't decide on repair cost alone.

dataNote.title: DATA NOTE:
dataNote.text: Vehicle values draw on live UK market pricing. Replacement costs are [EM-QUOTE] recon bands. Verdict flags apply the 60% rule against typical host values — always confirm with a specialist inspection of the specific car.
